title: Your card look
summary: The card people open in a drop: your logo, colour and background. Set it once.

steps.title: Open Card look
steps.body: Go to Settings, then Card look (under Drops). Your name, logo and colour come from your page, so it's mostly ready.

steps.title: Your look
steps.body: Add your logo (a square picture works best), pick your brand colour, and choose a background: your colour, a pattern or a photo. Tikka checks your colour so the writing on your card is always easy to read.

steps.title: Your code letters
steps.body: Every Tikka code starts with two letters, like GS for Glow Studio. Staff see them at the counter. Tap "Save my card" when you're done.

tips: Use a clear logo on a plain background. It shows small on phones.
